messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Errors when loading part 4
parts:
Hi Anna,
Probably the error you get relates to trying to use a sleeplog datafile (csv).
What value for argument loglocation do you use?
If you omit it or set it to c() then GGIR will try to estimate sleep
without the sleeplog, which should avoid the error. Note that with
argument sleep.def.noc you can control how GGIR should do this, but
you can leave that to it's default setting if you are just starting.
If you want to GGIR to guide the sleep estimates with the sleeplog
file then it may help to first get the sleeplog to work with GGIR
function g.loadlog. If it does not work then that hints at incorrect
format/structure of the csv file. When the output of that looks
correct it should also work when integrated in GGIR.

If the problem persists then please share a bit more detail about your
situation: Number of nights in the data file, GGIR version number, and
also it would help if you could establish whether it is a file
specific problem or a consistent problem in all your files. Sharing a
milestone files produced by part3 and the sleeplog csv-file will ease
helping you.
Vincent
